posts.title: My Range Hood's Buttons Were Flashing. A €0.90 Capacitor Fixed It.
posts.description: All four speed buttons blinking fast and a hood that refuses to start looks like a dead appliance. On a De Dietrich DHD120XE1 it is usually one tired electrolytic capacitor on the power board. Here is the symptom, the check and the fix.

posts.title: MikroTrick Hit My Router. The Alert Fired One Second Later.
posts.description: An unauthenticated RouterOS SSH exploit got admin rights on my MikroTik and planted a VPN backdoor in nine seconds. Off-box logging caught it in one. Real logs, what to check on your router, and why the patch matters more than your SSH keys.

posts.title: Bouygues Telecom TV Without the Bbox: IPTV Multicast Behind a GPON SFP Stick
posts.description: The exact config to get the Bbox TV decoder (Miami 4K) working with your own router and a GPON SFP stick: IGMPv2, 802.1p priority 5, an IGMP proxy and bridge snooping fixes.
